narrative.overview:
The site is one metro line drawn down the page. Black nameboards carry the names, a single fat signal-orange line runs down the left gutter from the first nameboard to a terminus, and everything the visitor reads sits on that line as a station or a stop on its branch. The world is transit wayfinding: enamel off-white ground, near-black signage with off-white type, ringed station dots, coloured interchange bullets. It is light only (`color-scheme: light`); there is no dark theme.

Density is generous and vertical. Content hangs off one continuous rail, sections abut so the line never breaks, and big condensed lettering does the work that imagery and cards would do elsewhere. Motion is lively but always optional: a "you are here" pin rides the line with scroll, past stations fill as they are reached, signs lift on hover, and tapping a Stack bullet isolates every stop on that track. Every bit of it is gated behind `prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference`, and content is fully visible without it.

The build is plain CSS: one global token file (`src/styles/global.css`) for tokens, base and the shared line pieces, plus each Astro component's scoped `<style>`. No Tailwind, no utility framework.
keyCharacteristics: One unbroken orange line, top to terminus, at a fluid 12-36px width.
Black rounded nameboards with heavy, extra-condensed Archivo lettering.
Station dots: off-white fill, thick black ring; only the current station is orange.
Interchange bullets in a fixed four-colour set, assigned by hashing the item name.
Archivo's width axis is the type system: 62% for nameboards, 75-87.5% for labels and subheads, 100% for reading.
Light only; motion is lively and entirely off under reduced motion.

rules.name: The Route-Only Rule
rules.body: Orange lives on the route, the current station, progress and "you are here". It never fills a button, a tag, a heading or a decorative block.

rules.name: The One Current Station Rule
rules.body: Exactly one station dot is orange-filled: the current role. Past stations fill black as they are reached; they never turn orange.

rules.name: The Hashed Track Rule
rules.body: Interchange colours come from the item name via `trackColour()`. Four colours, fixed; adding one is a system change.

rules.name: The Width-Axis Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy is carried by `font-stretch` as much as size: 62% for anything on a board, 75% for labels, 87.5% for signs and subheads, 100% for reading. Never fake condensing with a second family.

rules.name: The Timetable Rule
rules.body: Dates and numbers are tabular (`font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`) everywhere: `time`, ordered lists, tables, the footer.

rules.name: The Open Gaps Rule
rules.body: Condensed 900 lettering closes its word gaps; board lettering reopens them (`word-spacing: 0.16em`, headline 0.12em).

rules.name: The Flat Signage Rule
rules.body: Signage is flat at rest. Shadows are soft, ink-tinted and blurred, and only for hover lift or for markers that float above the line.

dos: **Do** keep the line continuous: every block on the route is an `.on-line` run, and the line ends only in the terminus dot or a branch's last stop.
**Do** set every board name in Archivo 900 at wdth 62% on an ink board, and reopen word gaps.
**Do** gate every animation and transition behind `prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference` (or remove it under `reduce`), with content visible by default.
**Do** keep focus visible: 3px solid ink outline, 3px offset; paper on ink surfaces.
**Do** write styles as plain CSS: tokens in `global.css`, layout in each component's scoped style.
donts: **Don't** use orange for anything that is not the route, the current station, progress or "you are here".
**Don't** add a dark theme; the system is light only.
**Don't** add a second typeface for display or condensing; use Archivo's width axis.
**Don't** add Tailwind or a utility framework.
**Don't** give station dots shadows or orange fills beyond the current station.
**Don't** use icon fonts or glyphs for icons; signs carry inline SVG.
